notes: UNMEASURED. Separate from moving-camera pixel tables. Measure angular corrections at a complete nominal-pan/nominal-tilt/nozzle-distance grid (at least 2 values per axis). Every row requires a unique measurement_id, measured=true, nominal_pan_deg, nominal_tilt_deg, nozzle_distance_m, angle_correction_deg=[pan_delta,tilt_delta] and actual measured_impact_error_m=[x,y,z]. Every interpolation cell also needs a distinct strictly-interior validation measurement with commanded_angles_deg equal to the interpolated target and actual measured_impact_error_m within the declared acceptance radius. These are actual water tests at the same installation and pump setting; no extrapolation or pressure/gravity guessing. Bind all calibration/profile/reference IDs after measurement. No sample values are supplied because none have been physically measured.
